alt: No 2008 model year in the US

issues.t: CVT shudder, whine and failure
issues.sym: Shuddering when pulling away, a whine or drone that rises with speed, slipping, or a pause before the SUV moves, often once it is warm.
issues.why: The first-generation CVT used in these Muranos wears internally. Nissan extended CVT coverage on these years, but those extensions have run out on nearly every vehicle.
issues.next: Have a transmission specialist inspect it and check for software updates. Fresh Nissan CVT fluid can help a mild case, but a failing CVT usually has to be replaced. Avoid hard driving until it is checked.

issues.t: Intake air duct cracks or separates (recall)
issues.sym: Rough idle, stalling, a hissing sound under the hood, or a check engine light.
issues.why: The rubber intake ducts shrink with age and can pull away from the air resonator as the engine moves. Nissan recalled these SUVs to inspect and repair them.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls and have the intake ducts inspected for cracks or loose joints.

issues.t: Camshaft or crankshaft position sensor failure
issues.sym: A check engine light, stalling, rough running, or an engine that cranks but will not start.
issues.why: The sensors that track engine position are a known weak spot on this V6. Some very early 2003 sensors were also recalled for a bad solder joint on their circuit board.
issues.next: Have the stored codes read. A failed sensor is usually a quick replacement, and early 2003 models should be checked for an open recall.

issues.t: Gear shown may not match gear engaged (recall)
issues.sym: The shifter indicator shows one gear while the transmission is actually in another, so the SUV can move unexpectedly.
issues.why: A nut on the transmission selector shaft could be loose on some early vehicles. Nissan recalled them to tighten it.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls. Always set the parking brake and do not trust the gear display until it is fixed.

issues.t: Alternator stops charging (recall)
issues.sym: The battery or charging light comes on, lights dim, and the SUV eventually will not start or stalls.
issues.why: A wire inside the alternator could break and stop it from charging the battery. Nissan recalled affected vehicles.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls. If the charging light comes on, get to a shop soon, since the car is running only on battery power.

issues.t: Fuel tank can be punctured by road debris (recall)
issues.sym: A fuel smell or gasoline dripping under the vehicle, often after driving over something on the road.
issues.why: Debris kicked up from the road could pierce the fuel tank. Nissan recalled these SUVs to add tank protectors.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls. If you smell fuel or see it dripping, do not drive it and keep it away from flames or sparks.

issues.t: Fuel tank vapor fitting can come off (recall)
issues.sym: A strong fuel smell around the vehicle or fuel leaking near the tank.
issues.why: A fitting for the tank's vapor line could detach and let fuel escape. Nissan recalled affected vehicles.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls. Do not drive it if you smell raw fuel and have it towed for repair.

issues.t: Rear seat belt webbing can be cut (recall)
issues.sym: Often no warning. You may spot fraying where a rear outer seat belt passes the seat back hinge.
issues.why: In a severe frontal crash, a sharp edge on the rear seat back hinge could cut the outer rear seat belts. Nissan recalled these SUVs.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls and have the fix done before carrying rear passengers.

issues.t: Key can come out when not in Park (recall)
issues.sym: The key can be removed or the steering lock can engage while the shifter is not in Park, so a parked SUV could roll.
issues.why: These SUVs did not meet the federal anti-theft and rollaway rule linking the key to Park. Nissan recalled them.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls. Until it is fixed, always shift to Park and set the parking brake before removing the key.

issues.t: Passenger airbag may be switched off (recall)
issues.sym: The passenger airbag off light stays on with an adult in the seat, or the airbag light comes on.
issues.why: A part in the seat's occupant sensing unit, and on 2009 models the airbag computer software after a dead battery, could wrongly turn off the front passenger airbag. Nissan recalled affected SUVs.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls and have the fix done. Do not ignore an airbag warning light.

issues.t: Brake valves may not close fully (recall)
issues.sym: The brake pedal travels farther than usual before the SUV slows down, and stopping takes longer.
issues.why: Valves in the ABS control unit could stay partly open. Nissan recalled affected vehicles, and the 2009 model drew many brake complaints.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls. If the pedal feels long or soft, have the brakes inspected before driving further.

issues.t: Tire pressure sensor nut can corrode and leak (recall)
issues.sym: A tire slowly loses air and the tire pressure light keeps coming on, mostly in areas that use road salt.
issues.why: The nut that holds the tire pressure sensor to the valve stem could corrode and crack, letting air seep out. Nissan recalled affected vehicles.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls and check tire pressures often until it is fixed.

issues.t: Inaccurate fuel gauge
issues.sym: The fuel gauge reads wrong or jumps around, and the check engine light may come on.
issues.why: The fuel level sensors in the tank can give bad readings. Nissan issued a bulletin calling for new main and sub sensor units.
issues.next: Track mileage between fill-ups so you do not run dry, and ask a dealer about the fuel level sensor bulletin.

issues.t: Tire pressure monitor not switched on at the factory (recall)
issues.sym: The tire pressure system never warns you even when a tire is low.
issues.why: On some SUVs the tire pressure monitoring system was not activated during assembly. Nissan recalled them.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls and check tire pressures by hand until the system is activated.

issues.t: Power steering hose can come off (recall)
issues.sym: Power steering fluid leaking, a whining pump, steering that suddenly gets heavy, or a burning smell.
issues.why: A clamp on a power steering hose may not hold, letting the hose slip off and spray fluid onto hot engine parts. Nissan recalled affected vehicles to install an updated hose.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls. If fluid is spraying or you smell burning, stop and have the vehicle towed in.

issues.t: ABS unit can leak and short out (recalls)
issues.sym: The ABS light stays on after startup, or there is a burning smell.
issues.why: Brake fluid can seep into the ABS pump's electronics and cause a short circuit that may lead to a fire. Nissan recalled affected Muranos in several campaigns to replace or fix the ABS actuator.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls now. If the ABS light stays on, park outdoors away from buildings until it is inspected.

issues.t: CVT judder and hesitation
issues.sym: A light shake through the pedal or steering wheel when pulling away or accelerating gently, hesitation, or whining, sometimes with a check engine light.
issues.why: The CVT in these years can develop judder. Nissan issued bulletins and software updates, and a class-action settlement extended CVT coverage on 2015-2018 models.
issues.next: Ask a Nissan dealer whether any extended CVT coverage or software update applies to your VIN, and keep records of all CVT service.

issues.t: Transfer case fluid leak on AWD models
issues.sym: Fluid drips where the front right axle enters the transfer case.
issues.why: A seal at the transfer case can leak, sometimes after a transmission replacement. Nissan covered the repair with a service bulletin. Running the fluid low can damage the transfer case.
issues.next: Have the seal replaced when you spot the leak and check the fluid level until it is fixed.

issues.t: Passenger airbag may turn off with an adult seated (recall)
issues.sym: The passenger airbag off light comes on even though an adult is in the seat.
issues.why: The occupant sensing system could misread who is in the seat and switch off the front passenger airbag. Nissan recalled affected SUVs.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls and have the fix done before carrying a front passenger.

issues.t: Hybrid system may shut down while driving (recall)
issues.sym: Warning lights come on and the SUV loses drive power.
issues.why: Software in the hybrid control system could shut down the powertrain. Nissan recalled affected Murano Hybrids for a software update.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls. If power cuts out, steer to a safe spot and have it towed or checked before driving further.

issues.t: Rear camera image can be hidden (recall)
issues.sym: When you shift into reverse the screen stays black or shows a settings menu instead of the camera view.
issues.why: A software problem let the camera settings screen stay over the backup image. Nissan recalled affected SUVs for a software update.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls and look over your shoulder when backing up until it is fixed.

issues.t: Front lower control arm can separate (recall)
issues.sym: Clunking from the front end, the SUV pulling to one side, or a sudden loss of steering control.
issues.why: Some front lower control arms could let the ball joint pull apart while driving. Nissan recalled affected SUVs to replace them.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls and have it fixed before regular driving. Any new clunk from the front end needs immediate attention.

issues.t: Weak steering knuckle or rear axle housing (recall)
issues.sym: Often no warning before a failure. You may notice clunking or the SUV pulling or wandering.
issues.why: Some steering knuckles or rear axle housings may not have been made strong enough and could crack. Nissan recalled affected vehicles.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls and get the parts inspected or replaced promptly.

issues.t: Front brake caliper may break (recall)
issues.sym: Grinding or scraping from a front wheel, the SUV pulling when braking, or a longer stop.
issues.why: Some front brake calipers may be weaker than specified and could crack. Nissan recalled affected Muranos.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls and have the calipers inspected before regular driving.

issues.t: Backup camera may not show (recall)
issues.sym: The screen stays blank or frozen when you shift into reverse.
issues.why: A software error in the display system can keep the rearview image from appearing. Nissan recalled affected SUVs for a software update.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls and use your mirrors and look behind you when reversing until it is updated.
